name: GSM-Plus
description: An adversarial extension of the GSM8K dataset designed to evaluate the robustness of large language models in mathematical problem solving by introducing various mathematical perturbations and testing model performance on question variations.
reputation: A newer adversarial math benchmark derived from GSM8K that is used to probe robustness to perturbations rather than broad community leaderboard performance.
notes: Focuses on robustness of math reasoning by testing LLMs on perturbed math problems; evaluates 25 LLMs and 4 prompting techniques.
